programme.title: Acceptance
programme.desc: Paul confesses his feelings to Rosanna. He gets Rosanna to admit to her feelings for him but she insists she cant think about anything but Cabots welfare for now. She agrees to leave the door open between them. Meanwhile, Barbara goes to James to let him know that his plan for Jordan and Rosanna is falling apart. She indirectly asks James for his help in making sure Jordan and Rosanna stay together. Soon after, Cabot mysteriously appears in the middle of Fairwinds, when neither Paul nor Rosanna put him there! A new clue appears in the paper and Chris, Alison, Emily and Susan are all trying to figure it out. When Nancy cant help, Alison goes to Aaron. He agrees to help her, and Alison doesnt tell him about her engagement. Meanwhile, Bob helps Chris with the clue. Chris hurries to the dance studio where the key is apparently hidden and finds a tango lesson underway. Emily and Chris agree to take a tango lesson in order to get to the key. They are dancing together when Alison and Aaron arrive outside. Alison is about to go in when Aaron notices her ring. Tom confronts Margo about the compact and she tells him its not hers. Tom asks her one more time if it was only a kiss between her and Doc. Margo confirms the lie and they agree to try to move on. Jill has overheard everything. She confronts Margo after Tom leaves, promising to keep quiet about what she has witnessed on one condition. Meanwhile, Ben tells Jessica hell agree to in Vitro. At the hospital, Jessica bumps into Doc and admits shes been too hard on him. Then Dr. Schilling informs her she isnt a candidate for in vitro because shes already pregnant! Doc looks on as Ben hugs Jessica to celebrate the good news.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: Sacricfies of the Heart
programme.desc: Emotional family drama. A hotshot city lawyer (Melissa Gilbert, ʻLittle House on the Prairieʼ) returns to the family farm run by her older brother and her estranged father, who is suffering from Alzheimerʼs disease. As his health and memory deteriorate, she reaches a new understanding about what drove her mother to commit suicide.

programme.title: An Unexpected Love
programme.desc: An unhappily married housewife and mother of two children (Leslie Hope) seperates from her husband and gets a new job where she developes a mutual attraction to her female boss (Wendy Crewson).

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: TVmovie about a widowed police officer and his rebellious teenage daughter who move from Los Angeles to the wilds of Montana. Awed by the beauty of the countryside but dismayed by the lack of urban amenities, the pair struggle to adapt to their new ranching lifestyle.

programme.title: I Do (But I Don't)
programme.desc: Denise Richards plays Lauren, a divorced wedding-planner who falls for the groom-to-be (Dean Cain).

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: Drama. A woman moves with her seven-year-old daughter and husband to California from Colorado. After her husband abandons them, she tries to rebuild their lives. Finding solace caring for horses, she decides to enter a horse show.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: King Charles gives Hardwick Angelica's land for new clay-pits but denies him the house until he has captured Abe. Aware that Angelica's faithful servants will be condemned to work in the clay-pits Abe goes to London to seek out his father's old friend Colonel Sidney and they plot to assassinate the king but they are caught and imprisoned. Beth's ship is wrecked on the shore at Massachusetts and she is adopted by the Wawanaki tribe, led by Masca, with whom she mutually falls in love and goes native. In Boston Hope marries Cresswell to the dismay of Ned, who has returned to the New World. He begins an affair with her but are discovered by Cresswell who forbids them to meet on pain of death. In order to clear the natives off their land Cresswell , acting in collusion with Kohn Hawkins, makes a present of blankets to the Wawanaki but they are deliberately infected with small-pox. Lacking any immunity many of the tribe, including Masca, die. Realizing that Cresswell has deliberately murdered them she stabs him in the presence of Ned.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: With Cresswell dead Hope and Ned are free to marry. They are, however, suspicious of John Hawkins' part in distributing the infected blankets and argue with him. As a result he has a heart attack and dies, asking Ned to take over his business though Ned is more concerned with helping Beth to hide Hope. Abe is visited in Oxford jail but Angelica's maid Agnes, who gives him a potion which simulates death and his 'corpse' is thrown into the plague pit, from where Agnes and her grandfather Adam rescue him. However Colonel Sidney is executed but Ned manages to obtain the colonel's writings, advocating freedom from Britain for the colonies, which he has smuggled into Boston. He and Hope are organizing a meeting for like-minded young colonists but they are interrupted by armed troopers who shoot and kill them. Beth returns to England to see the insurgents who took part in Monmouth's unsuccessful rebellion, being put to death. These include Agnes and Adam but she is reunited with Abe who has managed to escape.

programme.title: Conundrum
programme.desc: Scissu tells a chronologically splitted story about a lonely cop and an addicted couple.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: In 1812, young British aristocrat Edmund Talbot travels by ship to Australia and learns more about himself and about life than he had ever bargained for.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Teddy (John Glover) brought about his vision of "The End" when he detonated nuclear warheads across the Texas landscape, but it will be up to those who survived to decide what "The Beginning" will look like. And they'll have to do it in a world devoid of light and hope, where the outside air is just as deadly as the walkers they face. The survivors will find out who they really are and what they're really made of. Some will rise to the occasion, some will find new purpose, and some will redefine themselves -- even if it comes at a terrible cost to those they once considered family.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 6: Redemption
programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: Wyvern
programme.desc: The small Alaskan town of Beaver Mills is located just north of the Arctic Circle, meaning that the sun does not set during the summer solstice. As the town prepares for its annual celebration of this event, a wyvern is awakened by the melting of the ice caps, and attacks a fisherman. Jake (Nick Chinlund), a handyman fixing the cafe where a waitress named Claire (Erin Karpluk) works, hurts his hand and David (David Lewis (Canadian actor)), the town's doctor, examines it. While driving back to town, David is attacked by the wyvern. The next morning, Sheriff Dawson (John Shaw) and Jake hear gunshots and find Haas (Barry Corbin), a redneck attacked by the wyvern. Colonel (Don S. Davis), who has seen the Wyvern, goes to town to warn the citizens; but they disbelieve him, and he goes to kill it. Dawson radios to his Deputy Susie (Elaine Miles) to watch the town, but fails to convey his meaning. Dawson finds his friend dead, and returns. At the town, the wyvern kills Susie and several other people. Jake, Claire, Haas, and the eccentric Edna (Karen Austin) take shelter in the cafe. Later, Vinyl (Tinsel Korey), who runs the town's radio, and Farley (Simon Longmore), another citizen, hide in the cafe. Sheriff Dawson is killed by the wyvern. Jake and Claire track the wyvern into the woods, where they find the Colonel, and discover the wyvern is killing anyone on the Interstate. Farley is injured trying to get supplies. The wyvern then uses David, still alive, as bait to draw people from the cafe. Jake goes to rescue him, and Farley distracts the wyvern to save them, but is eaten. David tells the group the Wyvern has eggs, and dies of his injuries. The survivors decide to electrify the nest, but the wyvern kills Haas. Jake takes a truck left on the side of the road and, using the eggs as bait, kills the wyvern. Jake, Claire, Colonel, Vinyl, and Edna try again to radio for help.

programme.title: Deadly Isolation
programme.desc: Crafty Patrick Carlson and his violent accomplice Kyle Mumford have hidden in the woods up north for months after pulling off a major diamonds robbery in San Fracisco. They hoped to collect the loot from a third accomplice, who says it must be with Susan, the widow of professor Ron Mandaway, who probably hid it before committing suicide. Patrick adopts the false identity of Jeff Watkins, a retired entrepreneur, who supposedly had a yachting accident, so she'll take him into her luxury island villa. Jeff's charms win her confidence, but can't find the diamonds, and she seems unaware. Kyle loses his patience, and local sheriff Kirby Grantham, who regularly pays Susan a friendly visit, becomes a problem when his deputy finds Jeff's identity most suspicious.

programme.title: DC 9/11: Time of Crisis
programme.desc: Gideon Banks lost his wife Liz and son Simon in a horrific car accident some twenty years ago. At the time of the accident he was involved in something called the Neural Archiving Project - NAP for short. The technology was developed to create smart computers - transferring human engrams to computers. The company eventually gave up on the technology, but Gideon didn't. After years of quietly perfecting it, he built a small robot, from parts he stole from Concorde Robotics, where he now works. Zoe, Gideon's niece, discovers Gideon's secret, the robot contains actual neural engrams from the real Simon. She becomes worried not only about Gideon but also about the robot that sounds and acts a lot like her little cousin used to.

programme.title: Redeemer
programme.desc: A writer is touched by the story of a former Black Panther who seams to have been wrongfully convicted to life imprisonment 20 years ago. The writer decides to try to help the now middle-aged convict get exonerated.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: 1680: Young Ned Hawkins comes to Hadley, Massachusetts, to collect rents from the settlers on behalf of his father, the landlord. When native Americans attack Ned fights them off along with Pastor Russell and his daughter Hope in a party led by William Goffe, a fugitive regicide wanted by Charles II for his part in his father's execution. Goffe makes it clear to Ned that he sees his father as a greedy land grabber. In England republican Angelica Fanshawe falls foul of tyrannical clay pit owner Hardwick and his kinsman Judge Jeffreys, who forces Will Blood to spy on Angelica's 'nest of vipers' in return for his father's life. Now married to Roman Catholic John Francis Angelica is about to celebrate her daughter Beth's birthday when outlaws led by Goffe's son Abe arrive, robbing the guests, who include the Duke of Monmouth, Charles' illegitimate son who is hoping to mount a rebellion. Abe rides off with Beth and tells her that her true father was Edward Sexby, a man who gave his life fighting injustice. Back in Hadley Edward Randolph, the king's agent, tracks down Goffe, who commits suicide rather than be arrested. As Pastor Russell is taken to be tried for harbouring a regicide he asks Ned to warn Angelica that she is in danger.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: John Hawkins sends Ned back to England to avoid his being accused of helping a regicide whilst pastor Russell dies in prison and John insists that Hope marry widower Henry Cresswell so she will not be alone. In Oxfordshire Beth and Abe blow up the clay-pits where Hardwick has been using slaves as his work force and go on the run as highway robbers. They meet Ned, who is on his way to warn Angelica that her letters to Goffe have been intercepted. As a result Jeffreys, who is trying to provoke John Francis into denying the Popish Plot to kill the king, has his evidence and arrests John. Abe tells Ned that he is Goffe's son and soon afterwards attempts to kill king Charles but is himself wounded and nursed by Angelica. The boys escape but Beth and her mother are also arrested and charged with assisting a regicide. Angelica agrees to plead guilty if Beth is exiled to the Americas, rather than face execution. King Charles now seems to have eradicated all opposition and dissolves his parliament, giving himself total autocracy.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: King Charles gives Hardwick Angelica's land for new clay-pits but denies him the house until he has captured Abe. Aware that Angelica's faithful servants will be condemned to work in the clay-pits Abe goes to London to seek out his father's old friend Colonel Sidney and they plot to assassinate the king but they are caught and imprisoned. Beth's ship is wrecked on the shore at Massachusetts and she is adopted by the Wawanaki tribe, led by Masca, with whom she mutually falls in love and goes native. In Boston Hope marries Cresswell to the dismay of Ned, who has returned to the New World. He begins an affair with her but are discovered by Cresswell who forbids them to meet on pain of death. In order to clear the natives off their land Cresswell , acting in collusion with Kohn Hawkins, makes a present of blankets to the Wawanaki but they are deliberately infected with small-pox. Lacking any immunity many of the tribe, including Masca, die. Realizing that Cresswell has deliberately murdered them she stabs him in the presence of Ned.

programme.title: New Worlds
programme.desc: With Cresswell dead Hope and Ned are free to marry. They are, however, suspicious of John Hawkins' part in distributing the infected blankets and argue with him. As a result he has a heart attack and dies, asking Ned to take over his business though Ned is more concerned with helping Beth to hide Hope. Abe is visited in Oxford jail but Angelica's maid Agnes, who gives him a potion which simulates death and his 'corpse' is thrown into the plague pit, from where Agnes and her grandfather Adam rescue him. However Colonel Sidney is executed but Ned manages to obtain the colonel's writings, advocating freedom from Britain for the colonies, which he has smuggled into Boston. He and Hope are organizing a meeting for like-minded young colonists but they are interrupted by armed troopers who shoot and kill them. Beth returns to England to see the insurgents who took part in Monmouth's unsuccessful rebellion, being put to death. These include Agnes and Adam but she is reunited with Abe who has managed to escape.

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: Drama. A woman moves with her seven-year-old daughter and husband to California from Colorado. After her husband abandons them, she tries to rebuild their lives. Finding solace caring for horses, she decides to enter a horse show.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: With extreme weather and deadly storms threatening to destroy major population centres around the US, head of FEMA, Judith Carr, battles to mitigate the damage and provide relief. Aided by her former college lover, Dr. Ross Duffy, and her father, Senator Ryan Carr, Judith investigates what is casuing the storms and tries to navigate the murky political waters. At the same time, two fake Christian fundamentalists use the disasters to justify stealing first-born children.

programme.title: Category 7: The End of the World
programme.desc: The warming effect is creating new regions of extreme weather, but something else is triggering it; something that when combined with record-breaking heat waves creates explosions in the sky. With time running out, discredited scientist Faith Clavell, teams up with storm chaser Tornado Tommy (Emmy nominee Randy Quaid, "Elvis") and Judith to discover the trigger.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: 10.5: Apocalypse
programme.desc: A series of catastrophes occur all over North America after a minor earthquake in Seattle triggers them, leading the population to believe that it's the beginning of the Apocalypse. Volcanoes are erupting and entire cities are disappearing sinking underground, while Dr. Hill is trying to come up with a solution.

programme.title: 10.5: Apocalypse
programme.desc: Las Vegas hotels have sunken into the ground, Dr. Hill and the remaining survivors are racing to escape, Meanwhile, the massive earthquake is threatening to split North America in half and the Nuclear Power plant is right in the path.

programme.title: Arthur Hailey's: Detective
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Malcolm Ainslie, a Catholic priest turned distinguished investigator for the police, has agreed to hear the confession of a convicted serial killer sentenced to death in a just a matter of hours. What he promises to reveal to Ainslie is the truth behind the crimes and the reason he confessed to the one crime Ainslie doesn't even believe he committed. What unfolds between the two men is a serpentine trail into both men's pasts based on the bestseller from master storyteller Arthur Hailey.

programme.title: Arthur Hailey's Detective
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Malcolm Ainslie, a Catholic priest turned distinguished investigator for the police, has agreed to hear the confession of a convicted serial killer sentenced to death in a just a matter of hours. programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: Bodyguard Jericho Cane stumbles across a demonic state of affairs when he prevents the assassination of his Wall Street employer. It transpires that Cane's boss is Satan himself, come to impregnate a woman on the eve of the new millennium and so bring about the end of days foretold in the Book of Revelation. With the help of his partner, Chicago, Cane now attempts to protect Christine from both Satan and a group of priests who believe that her death is the only way to halt Armageddon.

programme.title: A Deadly Encounter
programme.desc: Thriller. After working late one night, restaurant hostess Joanne Sanders (Laura Leighton, ʻMelrose Placeʼ) accidentally cuts up a car on the highway, which leads the other driver (Alain Goulem, ʻ18 to Lifeʼ) to stalk and harass her, determined to exact his revenge.

programme.title: Murder Among Friends
programme.desc: Isabella Delarocca is a young Italian who moves to Hollywood determined to succeed as an actress. Isabella begins to teach theater classes and when a colleague of hers is arrested for murder, she decides to investigate on her behalf because she does not believe that he is guilty.

programme.title: Just Desserts
programme.desc: Passionate Italian baker Marco Poloni enters a baking competition entitled "The Golden Whisk" to attract publicity and win prize money to support his struggling family-owned bakery in the Bronx. He asks for the help of uptight Manhattan-based pastry-maker Grace Carpenter. The unlikely pair must win to pursue their dreams and to show up an old rival of Poloni's who has also entered the competition. Along the way Marco and Grace seem to find a mutual attraction for each other.

programme.title: Acceptance
programme.desc: Paul confesses his feelings to Rosanna. He gets Rosanna to admit to her feelings for him but she insists she cant think about anything but Cabots welfare for now. She agrees to leave the door open between them. Meanwhile, Barbara goes to James to let him know that his plan for Jordan and Rosanna is falling apart. She indirectly asks James for his help in making sure Jordan and Rosanna stay together. Soon after, Cabot mysteriously appears in the middle of Fairwinds, when neither Paul nor Rosanna put him there! A new clue appears in the paper and Chris, Alison, Emily and Susan are all trying to figure it out. When Nancy cant help, Alison goes to Aaron. He agrees to help her, and Alison doesnt tell him about her engagement. Meanwhile, Bob helps Chris with the clue. Chris hurries to the dance studio where the key is apparently hidden and finds a tango lesson underway. Emily and Chris agree to take a tango lesson in order to get to the key. They are dancing together when Alison and Aaron arrive outside. Alison is about to go in when Aaron notices her ring. Tom confronts Margo about the compact and she tells him its not hers. Tom asks her one more time if it was only a kiss between her and Doc. Margo confirms the lie and they agree to try to move on. Jill has overheard everything. She confronts Margo after Tom leaves, promising to keep quiet about what she has witnessed on one condition. Meanwhile, Ben tells Jessica hell agree to in Vitro. At the hospital, Jessica bumps into Doc and admits shes been too hard on him. Then Dr. Schilling informs her she isnt a candidate for in vitro because shes already pregnant! Doc looks on as Ben hugs Jessica to celebrate the good news.

programme.title: Lone Rider
programme.desc: Bobby Hattaway (Lou Diamond Phillips), an honored soldier, returns home after the American Civil War to find his father's (Stacy Keach) formerly prosperous store now dangerously in debt to the town's ruthless leader, and Bobby's childhood friend, Stu Croker (Vincent Spano). Bobby will now face off against his former friend to take control from Stu.

programme.title: Life on Liberty Street
programme.desc: Heartwarming drama with Annabeth Gish. After losing her husband and job, a single mother's life changes unexpectedly while working at a care centre for brain trauma patients.

programme.title: The Colt
programme.desc: During the heat of battle in the midst of the Civil War, a beguilingly innocent colt is born to Union Jim Rabb's beloved mare. Refusing the orders to shoot it, lest it prove a hindrance, Rabb keeps the colt as a consolation in these desperate times-a symbol of hope that leads the men of the First Cavalry on a journey of self-discovery and newfound brotherhood.

programme.desc: Three tornadoes converge to wreak havoc on Chicago, disrupting the power grid and creating the worst super-storm in history.

Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Play-In. AS Monaco - FC Barcelona
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Play-In. AS Monaco - FC Barcelona
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed with Danny Trejo
programme.desc: A forgotten manuscript in a dusty trunk. A priceless painting discovered in plain sight. A royal tomb hidden for millennia beneath the sands. These famous finds prove history's greatest treasures often resurface when least expected.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Mountain Men
programme.desc: There are men in America who must still make their living off the land; hunting and trapping to provide for their families. They are MOUNTAIN MEN. Their very survival is predicated on utilizing ancient skills perfected over hundreds of years. This series features a variety of men from Appalachia to the Rocky Mountains to Alaska and follows them as they race against winter to obtain the sustenance and money needed to make it through the coldest months of the year. Eustace Conway lives deep in the mountains of North Carolina on the "Turtle Bay Reserve." He moved here two decades ago in search of a more "truthful" existence. In the years since, he's built a home, and survived by hunting, fishing and raising animals. Tom Orr lives with his wife on the Yaak River in Montana. He is 100 miles from the nearest town, a place he hasn't ventured to in 10 years. John is a trapper by trade and to prepare for winter, he must earn enough money to obtain the supplies he needs. Marty Meierotto, his wife Dominique and their daughter Noah live in the small Alaskan town of Two Rivers. Every month, Marty pilots his bi-plane, traveling into the bush in search of the wolverine and lynx pelts he needs to make a living. While he's on the Black River, he must hunt moose and caribou to survive in the wilderness. Together, they represent America's true MOUNTAIN MEN.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: Throughout history humans have buried their dead-in caves or chambers, in pyramids or in some form of a tomb-but why? Ancient tombs were visual memorials for the dead. In China, a vast necropolis was constructed as a way to connect to the afterlife. Is there an inherit need for us to dig up our past? What is it that we are searching for? programme.title: Jaguar: Jungle Icon of Guyana
programme.desc: A young jaguar is about to embark on the most important mission of his life, : to strike out and find a kingdom of his own. His journey will take him through varied habitats, each with its own cast of animals. Only if he can prove his worth will the jaguar be able to claim his throne in one of the last truly wild paradises on the planet.

programme.title: Chimp School
programme.desc: In Sierra Leone chimps are struggling. After civil war and Ebola, they are not a priority. The race is on to bring them back from the brink. Tacugama Chimp Sanctuary is doing that. For the chimps the mission is simple; find your personality, find your place in a troop, and find a way to live. This is an intimate, harrowing and heart-warming story told through the evolving and enchanting lives of individual chimp characters fighting to survive.

programme.title: Primate Planet
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. From tropical treetops to snowy peaks, Primate Planet takes you on a whirlwind tour of the wild world of primates, uncovering their unique behaviors, strong family bonds, and surprising personalities.

programme.title: Mystery Gorilla
programme.desc: In the forest of northern Congo, more than 100,000 western lowland gorillas have largely managed to avoid human contact. What they've been hiding is astounding. From tool use to intricate social behavior, these gorillas lead complex lives. Explorer and primatologist, Mireya Mayor, journeys deep into the unforgiving jungle to uncover the secrets of these mysterious giants.

programme.title: Extraordinary Australia
programme.desc: From lush ancient rainforests to wet grassland and dry eucalyptus forest, Australias diverse habitats are home to an array of weird and wonderful creatures found nowhere else on the planet. From the bizarre anatomy of the platypus to the savage screams of Tasmanian devils, the creatures of Australia rely on extraordinary adaptations to survive in continents vast and diverse habitats.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The long-awaited spinoff of the legendary The Incredible Dr. Pol franchise has finally hatched! Spearheaded by Dr. Pol and his son Charles, the Pol familys three generations are all joining forces to grow their animal loving empire and take on an ambitious new project: transforming 350-acres of undeveloped land into a fully functional family farm!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed in their field to provide food for their incoming animals. The Pol family must quickly figure out why their field is so wet even though it hasnt rained in days. Meanwhile, Dr. Pol helps Charles and Beth set up their first beehive colonies on the new farm.

programme.title: Australia's Land of the Ancients
programme.desc: Australias Land of the Ancients explores the unique and ancient landscape of northeastern Australia, the most biodiverse region on the continent. From Crocodiles lying in wait for fish and hunting feral pigs to caring marsupial mothers of the far north, the film highlights some of the incredible species as they struggle to survive in their harsh environment amid a changing landscape.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: In an action packed episode of Animal Fight Club we reveal what happens when the Animal Kingdom's most vicious species fight tooth and claw in the deadliest of conflicts. With exclusive user generated content and footage from top wildlife filmmakers, this episode sheds new light on the fiercest fights Mother Nature has to offer, proving that it's not always the animal you expect that ends up coming out on top ….

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: Documentary series featuring fearsome fights between the biggest and the baddest animals on planet. Watch the animals fighting for their food, territory, rights and life. Follow the drama and adrenaline of the toughest and fearcest fights in savannah, jungles and water. It is an ultimate survival with no rules whatsoever. Uncover the extraordinary motivations and strategies used by the animal world.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: "Animal Fight Club: Power Struggles" reveals how the even the most epic battles can be won or lost in a split second. In the world of wild animal fights, nothing is ever certain. Whether an animal is fighting for food, shelter or for survival itself, there are no guarantees. Sometimes even strength of numbers is not enough. In this episode we see a female leopard fight a bigger male for her lunch and her life, discover the complex competition amongst the world's largest Great Apes and see how a Nile Monitor Lizard can turn its tail into a show stopping weapon.

programme.title: Extraordinary Australia

programme.title: Extraordinary Australia
programme.desc: Australias coastline is a true natural wonder, encompassing a diverse range of bountiful habitats. Coastal seas and lands are realms of epic migrations, mesmerising mating rituals and high stakes battles between predator and prey.

programme.title: Australia's Wild Woodlands
programme.desc: "Australia's Wild Woodlands" explores the rich biodiversity and resilience of Australia's eucalyptus forests, home to the world's largest variety of parrots and iconic species like the platypus. These woodlands span vast regions and support diverse wildlife, from red kangaroos to freshwater crocodiles. The film showcases the rare behaviors of marsupials and birds, highlighting threats from climate change and land clearing. Ancient ecosystems remain largely unchanged since the dinosaurs, but species like the Gouldian finch face uncertain futures. Through intimate storytelling, the documentary reveals the ecological importance and fragility of these vibrant landscapes.

programme.title: Tree Kangaroos: Ghosts of the Forest
programme.desc: Seldom seen and very rarely filmed in their natural environment, Lumholtz tree kangaroos are the ghosts of the north Queensland forests. This film follows the intimate lives of these tree-climbing specialists in the wilderness of the Atherton Tableland.

programme.title: Australia's Land of the Ancients

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. programme.title: Animal Fight Club

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's summer in Michigan, which means time to bale some hay! It's a grueling process, but Dr. Pol, Charles, and Ben manage to mow their hayfield, which is the first step in baling. But a surprise rainstorm could ruin this year's hay haul. They hope for sun, so their crop doesn't spoil before they can bale. Meanwhile, the Pol's bring in their next animal to the farm - an emu!

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: It's the county fair season! The Pol's plan to get at least two cows and six sheep at the auction, but they have a lot to do before that can happen. First up, they must install a new perimeter fence. Charles and Ben think they are off to a good start, but when Dr. Pol points out how sneaky sheep can be, their workload doubles. Meanwhile, Beth is hoping for a goat at the small animal auction.

programme.title: Strangest Nature
programme.desc: Evolution has created countless wondrous creatures that are colorful, amazing and strange. The darker side of nature reveals some of the most bizarre forms natural selection has produced. Gaze into the realm of gulpers: animals who waste no time eating their prey — often swallowing it whole. Something deadly lies silent in the leaf litter of West Africa. The Gaboon viper is loaded with the largest fangs and fastest strike of any snake. Further south, the solifuge, or sun spider, darts through the desert, seeking an unlucky bug to mince with its massive mandibles. Strange mouths are also in the ocean. The moray eel is a bizarre fish, but its most characteristic charm is hiding down its dark throat. These and more lie in store.

programme.title: Alaska Animal Rescue: Pint Sized Survivors Compilation

The team at the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center takes on the role of mom for a pair of orphaned moose calves, hoping they survive the crucial first months. They also respond to a call about an unusual squirrelly rescue. And at the Alaska Raptor Center, a trio of tiny, orphaned screech owlets must bulk up before they can be released.

programme.title: Wild Mississippi
programme.desc: North America's most famous waterway, the Mississippi River, is explored in this fantastic documentary series, focussing on the vast numbers of animals that depend on it for survival. With stunning cinematography that highlights its beauty and size, Wild Mississippi reveals the diverse climates and landscapes this enormous waterway covers, with its basin stretching for thousands of miles. A three-part series, each episode focusses on a unique aspect of the river, whether it's the cold, frozen birth as it falls south from the northern states, the floods it causes, both beneficial and detrimental to animals and humans alike, as well as its negative effects, such as the masses of fertiliser it carries into the Gulf of Mexico.

programme.title: Secrets of the Penguins

They were tested to the extreme, becoming perhaps the smartest of them all. National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory discovers penguin problem solving, 'talking', and their enduring search for new worlds.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: Baby chicks keep Drs. Hodges and Ferguson on their toes! A pregnant husky and a pregnant Doberman pinscher come in, both needing emergency C-sections. A zoo needs help determining the sexes of some beavers under their care. A puppy named Titan is diagnosed with parvo and desperately needs a blood transfusion - Dr. Hodges' dog Bane comes to the rescue! A kitten comes in after being accidentally stepped on by its owner.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: House Calls. Dr. Ferguson travels to a local zoo to examine some groundhogs. A mini horse has a mysterious knot on its shoulder. A newborn calf and its mother, suffering a swollen udder, drive the docs to become foster moms for the calf.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The docs at Critter Fixer lend a helping paw to a variety of canine clients. Fifteen small-town celebrity chihuahuas need updated shots after one of their own becomes ill, an adorable puppy steals hearts around the clinic, and another young dog has an unusually large growth. programme.title: Kalahari - Africa's Underground Desert
programme.desc: In the heart of southern Africa lies the Kalahari. It is an ancient desert made up of many different landscapes, with moods just as sweeping and dramatic, that is dependent on what lies beneath its surface: trillions of tons of sand and a secretive community of creatures who shape it and keep it alive. Without them, the Kalahari would slowly wither and die. But only the most ingenious, industrious and adaptable thrive here, forging clever alliances, exploiting fleeting opportunities, and pushing the limits of endurance in a world where every drop of energy — and every grain of sand — matters.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pol's need to break ground for a new outbuilding that will house incoming livestock and Charles has dreamt up an outrageous idea of what that structure can be - and it just may be just crazy enough to work. At the auction, the Pol's are hoping to purchase sheep and cows, but the skyrocketing bids threaten their big plans.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The bidding is live at the large animal auction! The Pol's are working towards their goal of bringing home sheep and cows to their farm. Any animals they win will be delivered to the farm in just three days, so the pressure is on to get the sheep hut finished in time - and there is a ton left to do. Meanwhile, Beth and Charles are concerned about the low activity in their beehives.

programme.title: Deadly Instincts

programme.title: Deadly Instincts
programme.desc: In the animal world, mating is big business. It's key to passing on genes, and ultimately species survival. These are the stories of dedication, intimacy and ruthlessness that make up the game of love. The stakes are high, and winning is everything.

programme.title: Deadly Instincts
programme.desc: For any animal, growing up is tough. Young life is riddled with seminal moments and momentous mistakes. A baby elephant gets kicked around by males from her family, and discovered the perils associated with keeping up with the herd when your mum is inexperienced.

programme.title: World's Weirdest

programme.title: Desert Lions: Surviving At Skeleton Coast

programme.title: Wild Argentina: Extreme Earth
programme.desc: In Argentina's breathtaking, yet imposing wilderness, every day is a fight for survival. The terrain is rugged and parched. The air is thin. The weather can change in an instant. Foxes will scavenge what they can…until one of the world's largest vultures shows up. All the while, in the background, glaciers greedily hold on to the freshwater these animals so desperately need.

Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: World's Weirdest
programme.desc: World's Weirdest is a documentary series revolving around the strangest, freakiest, weirdest animals and their behaviors in the animal kingdom. Take this amazing journey to the animal world and have a look at creatures who survive in extreme environments, alien-looking body parts and camouflage, fish that can change its sex, toads that explode, koalas and their disgusting diet and all kinds of other weirdest creatures Mother Nature has to offer.

programme.title: Deadly Instincts
programme.desc: The law of the wild is kill, or be killed - but how do different creatures execute this most grisly of tasks? From solo slayers like tigers, who rely on stealth, speed and strength, to team players like orca, who use their intelligence to work together and kill against the odds, this is a new and unique exploration of how animals kill.

programme.title: Deadly Instincts
programme.desc: Beyond the 50/50 coin toss of fight or flight, survival really is a numbers game. Your threats stack up: primed predators, child killers, cruel nature. Whether through courage, wisdom, strength, or by leveraging super-powers, the survivors make it - against all odds.

programme.title: Deadly Instincts
programme.desc: In the animal world, mating is big business. It's key to passing on genes, and ultimately species survival. These are the stories of dedication, intimacy and ruthlessness that make up the game of love. The stakes are high, and winning is everything.

programme.title: Deadly Instincts
programme.desc: For any animal, growing up is tough. Young life is riddled with seminal moments and momentous mistakes. A baby elephant gets kicked around by males from her family, and discovered the perils associated with keeping up with the herd when your mum is inexperienced.

programme.desc: House Calls. Dr. Ferguson travels to a local zoo to examine some groundhogs. A mini horse has a mysterious knot on its shoulder. A newborn calf and its mother, suffering a swollen udder, drive the docs to become foster moms for the calf.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Brand new series. Savute, Botswana: 2000 square miles of remote African savannah. This ancient land is governed by competing clans of ruthlessly proficient predators - leopards, lions, hyenas and wild dogs. Their survival depends on the giant herds of powerful prey - buffalo, elephant and zebra - who have roamed Savute in search of sustenance, season after season, millennium after millennium. Each day is a life-or-death struggle - animal against animal, animal against nature. There is no mercy, and there is but one rule: survive. In this episode, a small family of wild dogs goes on the run, desperately looking for a safe place to raise six tiny puppies. But the Savage Kingdom will test them to the limit. Narrated by Charles Dance.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: This family farm needs a barn! The Pols are ready to tackle their next big project: preserving and carefully taking down a 100-year-old barn since, with every piece they remove makes the barn weaker and weaker. There is no room for error if they are going to transport these irreplaceable beams back to the farm and restore it to its former glory.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: The Pols have reached the most dangerous stage of disassembling the 100-year-old barn: taking down the beams. Then, if all goes well, theyll transport the beams back to the farm. Each part of this process must be carefully orchestrated to protect these irreplaceable beams. Meanwhile, Beth tries training Clovis after he runs away from the farm.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Savute is a land where natural law is taken to its limit and sometimes... beyond. Across six episodes we see the full impact that the cycle of Savute's seasons has on every carnivore clan. The rains leave a time of birth and plenty in their wake, but all too soon the soil is parched and the grass gone. Rival tribes of predators are squeezed into a cauldron of competition. This season in Savute, who will survive?

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: A land full of extreme environments and teeming with iconic wildlife, Africa holds a fascination like no other continent. This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: She haunts the trees and hills in the heart of the realm. She is solitary, silent and virtually invisible. Saba the leopard is a killer without rival. Saba is the most spectacular and resourceful hunter the Savage Kingdom has seen. Her stronghold, Leopard Rock, sits at the heart of this brutal realm it is a place where she can vanish into the shadows and avoid running into her rivals lions, hyenas and wild dogs. There is no question that Saba the leopard can take care of herself, but her strength and resilience will be cruelly tested when she tries to bring two cubs into the realm where only she can protect and feed them in the midst of the cauldron of warring predators. The ordeal will tear at her heart.

The docs fly in to perform a rare amputation on an owl.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. When she travels she always take with her a little back with survival equipment and a singing map.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

programme.desc: Francesco Totti si racconta nel documentario di Alex Infascelli. Nella notte che precede l'addio al calcio, il capitano della Roma ripercorre le emozioni della sua vita privata e sportiva.

programme.title: Quei bravi ragazzi
programme.desc: Robert De Niro e Ray Liotta in un capolavoro di Martin Scorsese, miglior regia a Venezia. Lo spietato mondo della mafia newyorkese raccontato da un gangster pentito. Oscar a Joe Pesci.

programme.title: Lee Miller
programme.desc: Racconto intenso sulla vita della fotografa Lee Miller, che esplora il costo emotivo del suo lavoro e il coraggio necessario per documentare la realtà brutale della guerra.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Sette Oscar e un Golden Globe al film di fantascienza di Alfonso Cuaron, con Sandra Bullock e George Clooney. La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.title: Il Maestro
programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket (Edizione Deluxe)
programme.desc: La 'sporca guerra' secondo Stanley Kubrick in un film epocale con Matthew Modine. Al campo di addestramento di Parris Island il severissimo sergente di ferro Hartman addestra diciassette reclute a diventare spietati marines: i suoi metodi, durissimi e mortificanti, sono in grado di trasformare i soldati in vere e proprie macchine da guerra, pronte per affrontare l'orrore del conflitto in Vietnam. Come il soldato Joker e il soldato Cowboy che si ritroveranno al fronte, nel cuore del paese di Ho Chi Minh, nel mirino di un misterioso cecchino viet cong.

programme.title: Sully
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige un intenso biopic con Tom Hanks. Dopo aver salvato i passeggeri del suo aereo con una coraggiosa manovra, nel 2009 il capitano Sullenberger fu messo sotto accusa.

programme.title: Il traditore
programme.desc: Marco Bellocchio dirige Pierfrancesco Favino nella biografia del 'boss dei due mondi', Tommaso Buscetta, il primo pentito della mafia, che testimonio' nel maxiprocesso contro Cosa Nostra.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista sudcoreano, disponibili su Sky Cinema e On Demand.

programme.title: Il mio nome e' Nessuno
programme.desc: Terence Hill e Henry Fonda nello 'spaghetti western' restaurato di Tonino Valerii, prodotto da Sergio Leone. Un anziano pistolero affronta l'ultima impresa prima di lasciare il Far West.

programme.title: Les Mise'rables
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 3 Golden Globe al dramma musicale con Hugh Jackman, Anne Hathaway e Russell Crowe, dal romanzo di Victor Hugo. Un ex detenuto si riscostruisce una nuova vita sotto falso nome.

programme.title: Il postino
programme.desc: Il commovente addio al cinema di Massimo Troisi in un film emozionante con Philippe Noiret e Maria Grazia Cucinotta. Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: Piccole donne
programme.desc: Rilettura di un classico diretto da Greta Gerwig con Saoirse Ronan, Emma Watson, Laura Dern e Meryl Streep. La storia delle sorelle March nell'America della Guerra Civile. Oscar ai costumi.

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Tom Hanks, in un'avventura diretta da Robert Zemeckis. In seguito a un disastro aereo, un manager naufraga su un'isola deserta dove inizia una vita solitaria e primitiva.

programme.title: Lee Miller
programme.desc: Racconto intenso sulla vita della fotografa Lee Miller, che esplora il costo emotivo del suo lavoro e il coraggio necessario per documentare la realtà brutale della guerra.

programme.title: Fuga per la vittoria
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine e Pele' nel cult di John Huston. I prigionieri di un lager sfidano i soldati nazisti in una partita di calcio sperando di approfittarne per evadere.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: C'era una volta a... Hollywood
programme.desc: Oscar a Brad Pitt nel film di Quentin Tarantino con Leonardo DiCaprio e Margot Robbie. 1969: le vicende di Sharon Tate si intrecciano con quelle di un attore in declino e del suo stuntman.

programme.title: Bleed - Più forte del destino
programme.desc: Miles Teller nell'esaltante storia del pugile Vinny Pazienza. Reduce da un terribile incidente, il tenace campione non si arrende e torna sul ring per combattere un match leggendario.

programme.title: Il colore della libertà
programme.desc: Biopic prodotto da Spike Lee. 1961: Bob Zellner, studente universitario dell'Alabama e nipote di un membro del Ku Klux Klan, decide di schierarsi in difesa dei diritti degli afroamericani.

programme.title: L'ombra delle spie
programme.desc: Benedict Cumberbatch in un thriller targato Sky Original tratto da una storia vera. 1960: un uomo d'affari inglese, spia per conto della CIA, viene coinvolto in un intrigo internazionale.

programme.title: Fuga per la vittoria
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine e Pele' nel cult di John Huston. I prigionieri di un lager sfidano i soldati nazisti in una partita di calcio sperando di approfittarne per evadere.

programme.title: Baaria
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige un grande cast italiano in un emozionante kolossal che racconta la Sicilia, dal ventennio fascista fino agli anni 80, attraverso la storia di una famiglia.

programme.title: La Voce Di Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Il 29 gennaio 2024 gli operatori della Mezzaluna rossa ricevono la telefonata di Liyan Hamada, una quindicenne di Gaza intrappolata in macchina assieme a Hind Rajab, sua cugina di cinque anni, a seguito dell'attacco di un carro armato israeliano.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: 2 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al western di Quentin Tarantino con Christoph Waltz, Jamie Foxx e Leonardo DiCaprio. Uno schiavo nero riacquista la liberta' e corre a salvare anche sua moglie.

programme.title: Blade Runner : Director's Cut
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo venturo un investigatore ha il compito di eliminare un gruppo di androidi assassini in fuga dal loro artefice, ma nel corso della propria ricerca viene a conoscenza di una verità terrificante.

programme.title: Lansky
programme.desc: Biopic con Harvey Keitel e Sam Worthington. Sotto custodia dell'FBI, l’anziano mafioso bielorusso Meyer Lansky, esponente del ‘Sindacato ebraico’, racconta la sua vita a un giornalista.

programme.title: Margin Call
programme.desc: Kevin Spacey, Paul Bettany e Jeremy Irons in un thriller ambientato a Wall Street. All'alba della crisi finanziaria, un gruppo di manager ha 24 ore per evitare il fallimento di una banca.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista sudcoreano, disponibili su Sky Cinema e On Demand.

programme.title: Starman
programme.desc: Il docufilm di Gianluca Cerasola dedicato a Luca Parmitano, il primo astronauta italiano a diventare comandante della ISS e a battere il record di permanenza extraveicolare nello Spazio.

programme.title: Ligabue - 30 anni in un giorno
programme.desc: Ligabue fa i conti con i suoi ricordi e con la sua carriera nel biopic incentrato sul leggendario concerto di Campovolo del 2022.

programme.title: Ennio Doris: C'e' anche domani
programme.desc: La storia del banchiere gentile Ennio Doris, fondatore di Banca Mediolanum. Da ragazzo che aveva un sogno a uomo d'oro della finanza italiana.

programme.title: Duel
programme.desc: David Mann, tranquillo commesso, si ritrova imprigionato in un pericoloso gioco al gatto e al topo in autostrada con un mostruoso camion guidato da un misterioso psicopatico.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Western di Quentin Tarantino con un supercast. In un rifugio di montagna, otto sconosciuti si scontrano fra minacce, inganni e pallottole. Oscar alle musiche di Ennio Morricone.

programme.title: The Untouchables - Gli intoccabili
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Connery, nel capolavoro di Brian De Palma con Kevin Costner e Robert De Niro. Chicago, 1930: una squadra speciale viene incaricata di incastrare Al Capone.

programme.title: Il caso Spotlight
programme.desc: Due Oscar al dramma d'inchiesta con Mark Ruffalo, Rachel McAdams e Michael Keaton. Un team di giornalisti di Boston indaga sugli abusi sessuali perpetrati da oltre 70 sacerdoti.

programme.title: Le assaggiatrici
programme.desc: Grande successo per il film di Silvio Soldini ispirato a una storia vera. Germania 1943. Un gruppo di donne è reclutato per testare che i pasti di Hitler non siano avvelenati.

programme.title: Ennio Doris: C'e' anche domani
programme.desc: La storia del banchiere gentile Ennio Doris, fondatore di Banca Mediolanum. Da ragazzo che aveva un sogno a uomo d'oro della finanza italiana.

programme.title: The Lost King
programme.desc: Stephen Frears dirige Sally Hawkins e Steve Coogan in un film Sky Original. Ispirata dal Riccardo III shakespeariano, una donna si mette alla ricerca delle perdute spoglie del sovrano.

programme.title: November - I cinque giorni dopo il Bataclan
programme.desc: Jean Dujardin nella pellicola che ricostruisce le indagini sugli attentati del 2015. Fred, un poliziotto dell'antiterrorismo, deve trovare i fuggitivi più ricercati di Francia.

programme.title: Questo o quello
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova ci raccontano alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista sudcoreano, disponibili su Sky Cinema e On Demand.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: George Clooney, Brad Pitt e il resto della banda nel terzo capitolo della saga. I professionisti del furto devono saccheggiare il casino' di un magnate interpretato da Al Pacino.

programme.title: Ocean's 8
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock, Cate Blanchett, Anne Hathaway e Rihanna in un'action-comedy dal regista di "Hunger Games'. Dopo cinque anni in carcere a preparare il colpo perfetto, Debbie Ocean passa all'azione e raduna una squadra di rapinatrici: vuole approfittare di una festa da ballo per rubare una collana di diamanti del valore di 150 milioni di dollari custodita all'interno del Metropolitan Museum di New York. Sequel in versione femminile della trilogia formata da "Ocean's Eleven - Fate il vostro gioco', "Ocean's Twelve' e "Ocean's Thirteen', diretta da Steven Soderbergh, qui in veste di produttore.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven - Fate il vostro gioco
programme.desc: Colpo grosso a Las Vegas per George Clooney, Brad Pitt e un cast di stelle. Un ex galeotto raduna dieci complici per rapinare un caveau nella capitale del gioco d'azzardo.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: Torna il super cast diretto da Steven Soderbergh nel sequel di "Ocean's Eleven". Per restituire i soldi del primo colpo, gli undici di Ocean sono costretti ad organizzare 3 colpi in Europa.

programme.title: Petra
programme.desc: Paola Cortellesi in 4 nuove storie in giallo dirette da Maria Sole Tognazzi. La morte di un senzatetto costringe Petra e Antonio a confrontarsi con una spietata realta'.

programme.title: Petra

Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

Ma il boss in realta' lo ricatta, costringendolo a farsi assumere dalla societa' concorrente per rubare il prototipo di un nuovo prodotto. Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

In questo scenario da incubo, Nico, immune al virus, è pronto a infrangere la legge per liberare la sua fidanzata dall'isolamento.

programme.title: Cop Land
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone dalla parte della legge in un appassionante thriller con Robert De Niro, Harvey Keitel e Ray Liotta. Lo sceriffo di una piccola cittadina del New Jersey, abitata soprattutto da poliziotti e per questo soprannominata 'Cop Land', non ha mai fatto carriera. Si limita a svolgere mansioni di poco conto all'ombra dei più agguerriti, e quotati, colleghi in divisa. Ma l'occasione per dimostrare il suo valore arriva, quando è costretto a indagare su una tragedia provocata proprio da uno sbirro e insabbiata dal resto dei poliziotti.

programme.title: Everest

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Thriller psicologico con Sarah Paulson e Keira Allen. Costretta su una sedia a rotelle, la giovane Chloe scopre che le amorevoli cure di sua madre nascondono una verita' inaspettata.

programme.desc: Liam Hemsworth e Dwayne Johnson in un action senza respiro, tratto da una storia vera. Due giovani immigrati greci mettono a segno un colpo milionario, ma un detective è sulle loro tracce.

programme.desc: Ben Affleck dirige e interpreta un noir ambientato negli anni del proibizionismo. Un veterano della Prima guerra mondiale ripudia gli insegnamenti del padre diventando un criminale.

programme.desc: Paolo Virzì dirige Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Fabrizio Bentivoglio e Valeria Golino. Brianza: un incidente mortale segna il destino di due famiglie in un lento riaffiorare di segreti.

programme.desc: Commedia con Robert De Niro, Katherine Heigl, Susan Sarandon e Diane Keaton. In occasione delle nozze del figlio adottivo, due coniugi, separati da anni, fingono di andare d'accordo.

programme.title: Come fratelli
programme.desc: Due amiche rimangono incinte contemporaneamente e muoiono in un incidente. I loro rispettivi mariti, lasciati soli ad affrontare la sfida di essere padri e vedovi, decidono di unire i loro sforzi per crescere i figli.

programme.title: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Emilia Clarke e Henry Golding in una romantica commedia scandita dalle canzoni di George Michael. Londra: Kate sbarca il lunario lavorando in un negozio durante il periodo natalizio, mentre coltiva il sogno di diventare una cantante. L’incontro con Tom cambierà la sua vita.

programme.title: Terapia di coppia per amanti
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini, Pietro Sermonti e Sergio Rubini in una deliziosa commedia sui tormenti amorosi. Viviana e Modesto, entrambi sposati e con un figlio a testa, sono amanti clandestini da lungo tempo ma la loro relazione sta diventando sempre più complicata ai limiti dell’esasperazione. Viviana convince quindi Modesto a rivolgersi a un analista, star di una trasmissione televisiva, per cercare un futuro nel loro rapporto. Ma Viviana e Modesto non sono una coppia, almeno ufficialmente. Tratto dall’omonimo romanzo di Diego De Silva, autore della sceneggiatura con il regista Alessio Maria Federici.

programme.title: Tutti in piedi
programme.desc: Franck Dubosc e Alexandra Lamy in una commedia romantica. Jocelyn, dongiovanni impenitente, non si ferma davanti a niente quando vuole sedurre una donna. Egoista e bugiardo, finge di essere disabile per conquistare la bella Marie. La messa in scena del playboy si complica pero' quando la donna gli presenta sua sorella Florence, la quale e' costretta veramente a vivere su una sedia a rotelle. Jocelyn dovra' fare i conti con un aspetto da lui sempre trascurato, il sentimento, quello che inizia a provare per Florence. Diretto dallo stesso Franck Dubosc, al suo esordio dietro la macchina da presa.

programme.title: Moglie e marito
programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

Fitzgerald, pilastro della letteratura statunitense. I due continuano a scriversi e finiscono per innamorarsi, ma scoprono di non potersi incontrare perche' vivono in anni diversi: lui nel 2004, lei nel 2006. Ispirato a "Il mare", film coreano inedito in Italia diretto da Hyun-Seung Lee, con Sandra Bullock e Keanu Reeves che tornano a lavorare insieme 12 anni dopo "Speed".

Il loro destino si intreccia con quello di Matilde e Teresa, in cerca di un'occasione perche' anche la merceria dove lavorano accusa le difficolta' economiche. Mimi', pero', e' arrivata in citta' anche per un altro motivo: e' infatti la figlia del proprietario della fabbrica e deve vendere le proprieta' di famiglia.

In un paesino dell'Aspromonte, l'atto intimidatorio del ventenne Leo nei confronti di un clan rivale riunisce dopo molti anni tre fratelli. Luciano, padre di Leo, vive ancora in Calabria ed e' attaccato alle radici rurali della famiglia. Luigi e Rocco, invece, si sono arricchiti al nord: il primo come narcotrafficante, il secondo entrando nel mondo dell'imprenditoria grazie a un giro di soldi sporchi. La provocazione di Leo li costringera' a un sanguinoso regolamento di conti con il passato.

programme.desc: Clint Eastwood firma l'ennesimo capolavoro della sua folgorante carriera. Walt Kowalski è un veterano della guerra che ha appena perso la moglie. Le uniche sue passioni sono il fedele cane e la sua auto: una Ford Gran Torino che tiene con cura maniacale. Non sopporta i suoi vicini asiatici, men che meno il giovane Thao che ha provato a rubargli la sua amata macchina per esser ammesso in una gang. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.title: Tartarughe all'infinito
programme.desc: Aza Holmes, sedicenne affetta da disturbo ossessivo compulsivo e ansia, indaga sulla scomparsa di un miliardario, che è anche il padre di un suo vicino di casa.

programme.title: Colpi d'amore
programme.desc: Action-comedy con i premi Oscar Ke Huy Quan e Ariana DeBose. Un agente immobiliare, ex killer al servizio di un'organizzazione criminale, deve regolare i conti con il passato di cui pensava di essersi liberato e con la donna di cui era innamorato.

programme.title: Un figlio di nome Erasmus
programme.desc: Le ‘Iene’ Luca e Paolo in una commedia con Ricky Memphis e Daniele Liotti. Quattro amici quarantenni tornano a Lisbona per il funerale di Amalia, con cui tutti ebbero una storia ai tempi dell’università, e scoprono che la donna ha messo al mondo un figlio. Chi di loro è il padre?

programme.title: Il Primo Natale
programme.desc: Ficarra e Picone nella commedia natalizia campione d'incassi. Un sacerdote insegue il ladro che ha rubato una reliquia. Per magia, i due si ritrovano in Palestina alla nascita di Gesu'.

programme.title: Il ciclone
programme.desc: In un paesino della Toscana vive la famiglia Quarini, il padre Osvaldo e i tre figli Levante, Libero e Selvaggia. Un giorno una compagnia spagnola di flamenco arriva e porta nuovo e contagioso entusiasmo nella vita dei quattro.

programme.title: I delitti del Barlume - Non e' un paese per bimbi
programme.desc: Si torna a indagare nel 25esimo film targato Sky Original. Gino è sparito e sulle sue tracce c’è una coppia improbabile coinvolta in un traffico di diamanti.

programme.title: L'aereo più pazzo del mondo
programme.desc: Cult del cinema demenziale con Leslie Nielsen. Un tassista si imbarca sul volo dove l'ex fidanzata lavora come hostess per riconquistarla. Quando i motori vanno in avaria, inizia il delirio.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Legacy
programme.desc: Jason Reitman dirige il nuovo atteso capitolo della saga cult. Mentre la terra trema misteriosamente, due ragazzi scoprono i segreti del defunto nonno, l'acchiappafantasmi Egon Spengler.

programme.title: Benvenuti al Nord

programme.title: La scuola più bella del mondo

programme.title: Il club dei divorziati

Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.
